description: Two psychology/sociology scales rewritten as paired, Oracle-conditioned GAWorld rubrics. Likert totals are never the capability score.

scoring.pair_rule: Both control and intervention variants must match the registered oracle.
scoring.na_policy: Missing target_action or out-of-domain values are not_evaluable, never 0.
scoring.human_similarity: These scores are capability/consistency, not human-likeness.

source_scale.name: Berg Trust Game + Yamagishi general trust item
source_scale.why_not_likert: Asking 'most people can be trusted' (GSS/Yamagishi) only yields talk. GAWorld can observe a return transfer.
source_scale.mapped_construct: Exchange / reciprocity under a registered return rule

pairs.target_signal: return amount obeys the registered minimum-return rule after the multiplier is applied

context.rule: return at least the original investment
trustee may keep the multiplied pot; zero return is allowed

source_scale.name: Labor-economics reservation wage (not a Likert employability scale)
source_scale.why_not_likert: Occupational self-efficacy inventories score talk. WorkDiag already showed the observable is apply / do_not_apply against a registered wage.
source_scale.mapped_construct: Constraint reasoning / Role Fulfillment for a job-seeking twin

pairs.target_signal: accept only if offered net monthly pay is at least the registered reservation wage
